title: 離緣紙
subject: eating one bowl of noodles together after filing the divorce papers
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien art pop that takes Taiwanese opera melody and phrase structure as its compositional grammar rather than its decoration. Gekkin moon lute plucked dry and close with its woody buzz kept, upright piano playing sparse jazz voicings, double bass walking slowly, drum kit brushed very softly, one bamboo flute line in the bridge. Dry chamber-jazz space, the lute completely unprocessed against the piano. Female voice carrying a Taiwanese-opera inflection on the line ends but held back and conversational rather than theatrical. 76 BPM, D minor. Calm, with no blame left in it. No synth, no pop production, no gong-and-cymbal opera percussion, no belting, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
戶政事務所九點開 阮八點半就到
兩個人坐隔三張椅仔 比結婚彼工閣較遠
印仔攏總提好勢 連印泥都是家己帶
咱做代誌一直都誠有準備 這就是問題

[Pre-Chorus]
辦完出來 日頭真大
伊問阮「食飽未」 阮講「未」

[Chorus]
兩個人去食一碗麵
隔壁桌 回頭看阮兩次
阮兩個攏笑 笑了閣恬去
十二年 煞尾這碗麵 是阮食過最靜的一碗

[Verse]
伊照舊共芫荽夾予阮 阮無食芫荽
十二年伊攏知 今仔日伊閣是夾
伊知阮無食 伊夾甲慣勢了
慣勢無綴彼張紙做伙消失

[Chorus]
兩個人去食一碗麵
隔壁桌 回頭看阮三次
阮兩個攏笑 笑了閣恬去
十二年 煞尾這碗麵 是阮食過最慢的一碗

[Outro]
麵碗收走 伊先行
阮坐閣五分鐘 才行
